escalations.title: Vitest UI Server Arbitrary File Read/RCE
escalations.detail: When Vitest UI server is listening, any attacker on the network can read and execute arbitrary files. Zero-precondition exploit.
escalations.fix: npm update vitest to v3.2.6+ in Source/Frontend
escalations.escalation_reason: RCE — supply chain risk; zero-precondition exploit on dev network

escalations.title: Protobufjs Arbitrary Code Execution
escalations.detail: Code injection via protobuf object property pollution and bytes field defaults. Production dependency via OpenTelemetry instrumentation. Malformed protobuf messages trigger RCE.
escalations.escalation_reason: RCE in production dependency — malformed protobuf message triggers code execution

escalations.title: OpenTelemetry Exporter Process Crash (DoS)
escalations.detail: Malformed HTTP request to /metrics endpoint crashes the entire Portal Backend process. Any unauthenticated attacker can trigger complete service unavailability.
escalations.escalation_reason: Zero-precondition DoS — crashes entire backend service; /metrics is publicly accessible

escalations.title: Form-Data CRLF Injection
escalations.detail: CRLF injection in multipart form field names and filenames allows HTTP header injection attacks, response splitting, and cache poisoning.

p1.title: Missing /api/search Route
p1.detail: GET /api/search is never registered in Express. search.test.ts self-documents this. DependencyPicker typeahead is silently broken in production — users cannot search dependencies.
p1.fix: Implement search handler (filter store by title/description; exclude soft-deleted; return {data:T[]}) and register app.use('/api/search', searchRouter) in app.ts.
p1.exploit_scenario: Users cannot add dependencies via DependencyPicker — feature is non-functional. 5 tests permanently fail.
p1.impact: Core feature broken; 5 failing tests hidden by narrow enforcer scope

p1.title: Vitest UI Server Arbitrary File Read/RCE
p1.detail: GHSA-5xrq-8626-4rwp — CVSS 9.8. Vitest UI server exposes arbitrary file read/execution to any network attacker.
p1.fix: npm update vitest to v3.2.6+ in Source/Frontend
p1.exploit_scenario: Attacker on dev network sends crafted request to Vitest UI server; reads .env files, executes arbitrary code.
p1.impact: Complete developer machine compromise if Vitest UI server is exposed

p1.title: Protobufjs Arbitrary Code Execution
p1.detail: GHSA-xq3m-2v4x-88gg — CVSS 9.8. Protobufjs code injection via property pollution. Production dependency via OpenTelemetry gRPC instrumentation.
p1.exploit_scenario: Attacker sends malformed protobuf message; server executes attacker-controlled code.
p1.impact: Full server compromise in portal/Backend production

p1.title: OpenTelemetry Exporter Process Crash (DoS)
p1.detail: GHSA-q7rr-3cgh-j5r3 — CVSS 7.5. Malformed HTTP to /metrics crashes entire backend process. Zero-precondition.
p1.exploit_scenario: Attacker sends one malformed GET /metrics request; portal/Backend crashes immediately; service unavailable.
p1.impact: Portal Backend complete outage; no crash loop protection noted

p2.title: Route Handlers Bypass Service Layer
p2.detail: All work-item CRUD and intake handlers call store.* directly. CLAUDE.md mandates service layer. Unit testing business logic requires HTTP plumbing.
p2.fix: Extract Source/Backend/src/services/workItemService.ts; route handlers call only service functions.

p2.title: dependencyCheckDuration Histogram Missing
p2.detail: FR-dependency-metrics requires 4 Prometheus instruments; only 3 exist. dependency_check_duration_seconds histogram absent — no latency observability for BFS cycle detection.
p2.fix: Add Histogram for dependency_check_duration_seconds in metrics.ts; instrument detectCycle, isReady, computeHasUnresolvedBlockers in dependency.ts.

p2.title: Traceability Enforcer Critically Narrow Scope
p2.detail: Enforcer scans only the single most-recently-modified requirements.md and only Source/ + E2E/. portal/ (112 FR IDs) and Specifications/tiered-merge-pipeline.md are permanently excluded.
p2.fix: Add portal/Backend and portal/Frontend to source_dirs; add --all-plans flag; register tiered-merge-pipeline.md as directly enforceable spec.

p2.title: FR-TMP-001–010 (Tiered Merge Pipeline): 0% Implementation
p2.detail: 10 active FRs for risk classification, E2E test generation, Playwright runner, auto-PR, AI PR review have zero traced implementation in Source/, portal/, or E2E/.
p2.fix: Open plan to implement spec OR add '## Status: Deferred' section to formally exclude from coverage.

p2.title: Duplicate Frontend Test Files
p2.detail: Two test pairs for same components: top-level tests/WorkItem*.test.tsx vs newer tests/pages/ variants. Doubles test time; creates maintenance divergence.
p2.fix: Delete top-level duplicates; keep tests/pages/ variants (more thorough).

p2.title: Form-Data CRLF Injection
p2.detail: GHSA-hmw2-7cc7-3qxx — CVSS 7.5. CRLF injection in multipart form field names allows HTTP header injection and response splitting.

p2.title: Vite fs.deny Bypass (Path Traversal)
p2.detail: GHSA-fx2h-pf6j-xcff — Multiple path traversal vulnerabilities in Vite. fs.deny bypass on Windows, .map file exposure, UNC path NTLMv2 hash disclosure.
p2.fix: npm update vite to ≥5.4.3 in Source/Frontend

p2.title: React Router Open Redirect
p2.detail: GHSA-2j2x-hqr9-3h42 — Protocol-relative URL redirect enables phishing. Fix is in v6.30.4; currently on v6.30.3.
p2.fix: npm update react-router-dom to ≥6.30.4 (patch version bump)

p2.title: gRPC Server Crash from Malformed Requests (DoS)
p2.detail: GHSA-5375-pq7m-f5r2, GHSA-99f4-grh7-6pcq — CVSS 7.5. Malformed compressed gRPC messages crash server. Cascades from OpenTelemetry upgrade.
p2.cross_ref: DEP-002, DEP-003 — same root cause (OpenTelemetry upgrade)

p2.title: ws WebSocket Memory Exhaustion (DoS)
p2.detail: GHSA-96hv-2xvq-fx4p — CVSS 7.5. Memory exhaustion via fragmented WebSocket streams. Cascades from Vite upgrade.
p2.fix: npm update vite (cascades ws dependency to ≥8.21.0)

p2.title: Path-to-Regexp ReDoS
p2.detail: GHSA-37ch-88jc-xwx2 — CVSS 7.5. Catastrophic backtracking in route matching via crafted URL patterns. Cascades from gRPC upgrade.
p2.cross_ref: DEP-002, DEP-003, DEP-007 — same root cause (OpenTelemetry upgrade)

p3.fix: Add @opentelemetry/* SDK init, HTTP auto-instrumentation, custom spans for BFS/assessment, traceparent header extraction in app.ts.
